sec: sec:C007: Flag high risk outputs for human review / Control mays

blocks.id: blk:C007: Flag high risk outputs for human review / Control mays/1
blocks.text: Establishing human review workflows for flagged high-risk outputs. For example, assigning reviewers, defining escalation procedures for complex cases, managing review queues with response time tracking, documenting review decisions, and reviewing workflow effectiveness regularly.
